name: Codex 模型桥接 / Codex Bridge
description: 通过独立宿主服务将本地 Codex 接入 Aide 模型提供商，支持三端安装、SSE、工具交接和有界并发。 / Local Codex model-provider adapter.

bridgeKey.title: 可选诊断密钥 / Optional diagnostic key
bridgeKey.description: Only needed for authenticated model catalog checks. Configure the same key separately in the Aide model provider; never paste it into chat.

managerURL.title: 宿主管理地址 / Manager URL

managerKey.title: 宿主管理密钥 / Manager pairing key
managerKey.description: Copy once from the native manager setup window. Allows fixed host lifecycle actions; different from the model API key. Never paste into chat.

author: skyelan1999
